title: Zesty Crispy Italian Foie Gras Pasta
description: A jammy, springy Italian pasta that pairs crispy double-fried foie gras with zesty lemon and fresh parsley over orecchiette.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat and add the olive oil.
Slice the 150g foie gras into 1cm thick medallions and season with salt and pepper.
In a shallow bowl, dredge the foie gras slices lightly in flour, shaking off excess.
Fry the foie gras at 140°C for 2 minutes until cooked through, then transfer to a plate.
Increase the skillet heat to 185°C and return the foie gras to the pan, frying for an additional minute until crisp and golden.
Meanwhile, boil 200g orecchiette in salted water for 10 minutes, then drain and set aside.
In the same skillet, sauté the minced garlic in the remaining oil for 30 seconds, then add the white wine and simmer until reduced by half.
Stir in the lemon zest, lemon juice, and a pinch of chili flakes, then toss the drained pasta into the sauce.
Plate the pasta, top with the double-fried foie gras slices, sprinkle with grated Parmesan, chopped parsley, and serve immediately.
